inputs:epidat/data-2026-08-13.title: Epidat research data (TEI/EpiDoc and cemetery table), commit 61046f3
inputs:epidat/data-2026-08-13.description: The research data repository of Epidat (Steinheim-Institut), named as the harvesting interface by https://www.steinheim-institut.de/cgi-bin/epidat?info=howtoharvest, at commit 61046f34c3e9e898bfc0c43d27cde8dd6abbd28d (2026-08-13). epidat-tei.tar.gz is the GitLab repository archive of the folder xml/tei at that commit (api/v4/projects/49332/repository/archive.tar.gz?sha=61046f34c3e9e898bfc0c43d27cde8dd6abbd28d&path=xml/tei, downloaded 2026-10-12): 48,041 EpiDoc TEI files, one per gravestone, in 268 cemetery folders; 63 are not well-formed XML. epidat-metadata.tsv is tsv/epidat-metadata.tsv at that commit: 603 cemeteries with code, name, country, coordinates, TGN and GeoNames numbers. Licence CC BY 4.0 (stated in every TEI file).
inputs:epidat/data-2026-08-13.note: Not published: a copy of a public source, kept to make the dataset epidat reproducibly.

inputs:epidat/persdata-2026-08-13.title: Epidat: person table (tsv/epidat_persdata.tsv) at commit 61046f3
inputs:epidat/persdata-2026-08-13.description: tsv/epidat_persdata.tsv of the Epidat research data repository at commit 61046f34c3e9e898bfc0c43d27cde8dd6abbd28d (2026-08-13; the file was added in 2da218ff, 2026-01-28, 'Upload epidat_persdata v01'), downloaded 2026-10-15 through api/v4/projects/49332/repository/files/tsv%2Fepidat_persdata.tsv/raw?ref=61046f34c3e9e898bfc0c43d27cde8dd6abbd28d: 10,441 persons (UTF-8 with BOM, tab-separated, 21 columns: persid, grabid, dates of death and birth, names, childOf/spouseOf as names, gedenkbuchID, yadvashemID, comments). Same commit as epidat/data-2026-08-13. Licence CC BY 4.0 (as the repository).
